note: A design roadmap for the social registry. It names a CVRS Database as a potential source of births and deaths 'when available', a 'planned' CRVS data collection exercise and a national ID enrolment 'yet to commence', all prospective and undated (missions November 2017 to May 2018); it says nothing of how or where a birth or death is recorded, so the CVRS Database is unclassified and gives no fact.
